title: Etryval (Alpha Test)
body:
![Etryval Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee3ce2149be59d15f9a8d3ed357f378827fc0cc4.png)  
**Etryval** is the idea that true survival is not about what is added, but what endures.
Etryval means “the eternal trial of survival.” _(don't mind the letter "y", I just wanted to make it sounds cool)_  

# What you'll found in Etryval:  
- Planes
- Battle Towers
- Giants
- and much more (that's for now, I'm lazy to write)
